lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple rows of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in a semi-regular grid extending from the posterior margin of the gill slits across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of slightly elevated pixel intensity that intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a non-orthogonal grid-like pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature running along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with higher pixel values on the dorsal aspect and shadow-cast lower values on the ventral aspect.
